patches.value: Complete N001 package: identify the guarded extended-diameter infima with bounded real-diameter covers at positive scale; explicitly reindex arbitrary countable families with empty padding and equal union/cost; prove scale monotonicity, both infimum bounds, positive-real-scale supremum, and the two zero/cheap-cover equivalences. Use the pinned hausdorffMeasure_apply formula directly with the Borel structure fixed by H. No measurability or boundedness of A is assumed; the empty admissible family has infimum ∞. Strict inequalities compare with ofReal ε only when ε>0. Pending internal repair: u denotes the shared ambient level and v the independent countable-index level. These names are not currently declared by the frozen header or the documented step schema; the actual strict check rejects them. Consumers additionally need an explicit level-zero specialization at the Euclidean handoff and at the finite-fiber countable index. This draft preserves the complete producer proposition and is not a checked repair.
